portfolio_view: Five picks span five distinct sectors — financial-market infrastructure (MCX), wire & cable manufacturing (RRKABEL), pharma CDMO (LAURUSLABS), premium spirits (RADICO), and telecom/optical fibre (HFCL) — each carrying a real, independently-verified earnings driver rather than a shared macro bet. Regime is DEFENSIVE (48.6% of universe above 200-DMA, half-size mandated), so conviction skews MEDIUM except where a daily-analyst overlap adds confirmation; treat all entries as half-size per the risk engine. FINCABLES (also daily-analyst BUY) was passed over for RRKABEL — same cable/capital-goods exposure, but RRKABEL's conviction score (76.9 vs 69.0) and earnings acceleration (TTM +81% vs +29%) are meaningfully stronger, and holding both would double up the same sub-theme.
theme_read: Shipbuilding & marine (heat 79.0) looks like the clearest case of mechanical heat running ahead of reality — Cochin Shipyard publicly denied the "40-ship export order" story on Oct 9 that was driving this week's thematic intelligence read, which is why KMEW, despite being the only starred (*) candidate beneficiary, was dropped entirely. Power transmission & grid capex (heat 76.0) is genuinely early with a dated, Cabinet-approved ₹1.86 lakh-cr catalyst, but the direct beneficiaries are KEI/SKIPPER/TARIL/APARINDS — RRKABEL is a building-wire/FMEG/export name with only loose linkage, so its inclusion here rests on its own deleveraging story, not the theme. Pharma CDMO & API (heat 71.7) had no fresh driver this week and is explicitly "fading on silence," yet LAURUSLABS trades near the top of its 10-year valuation band — a sign news flow has gone quiet just as price has not cooled. Data centres & digital infrastructure has the lowest heat (31.3) and least actionable breadth of any theme, yet carries the most concretely dated tailwind (CBRE-confirmed $173bn committed capex) — news is running ahead of price/heat here, and HFCL is the genuine expression, though its own earnings-volatility history is the bigger risk than the theme.
